facts.fact: Techzim states the Act made POTRAZ the Data Protection Authority, which issued a Regulatory Notice 2 of 2026 on compliance inspections; dated by the article's publication date, 2026-07-28.

Techzim describes the Act as the law under which POTRAZ will inspect data controllers from 1 September 2026 and under which a licence deadline of 12 March 2025 has already passed; dated by publication.

Techzim states that Statutory Instrument 155 of 2024, published in September 2024, requires any organisation processing personal data to hold a data controller licence, with a deadline of 12 March 2025.
facts.system: Cyber and Data Protection (Licensing of Data Controllers and Appointment of Data Protection Officers) Regulations, 2024 (SI 155 of 2024)

facts.fact: Techzim reports POTRAZ's Regulatory Notice 2 of 2026, published in the press the Sunday before 28 July 2026, announcing mandatory risk-based compliance inspections of data controllers from 1 September 2026, starting with financial institutions, insurers, local authorities, health providers, mining firms, schools and others; no decision is reported.
Techzim reports the regime moving from licence registration to mandatory inspections from 1 September 2026, announced by Regulatory Notice 2 of 2026 in July 2026.
